MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 29.1% and weak, narrow breadth: 0/8 sectors positive over 1W. Participation is broadly negative despite volatility remaining below the high-volatility threshold.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Holding & Investment (-2.53% 1W), Retail & Food (-3.24%) and Transportation (-3.35%) were the relative leaders, although all sectors fell. Within them, SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%) is RECOVERY; SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%) is BELOW TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom (-13.92% 1W), Energy & Chemicals (-10.21%) and Heavy Industry (-8.49%) were the weakest sectors. KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%), GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%) and VESTL (1W: -19.50% | 1M: -38.34%) are all BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
The best relative performers were HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%), RECOVERY; SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), RECOVERY; and SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%), BELOW TREND. ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%) and TAVHL (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -2.57%) are also BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
The weakest were KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%), GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%), VESTL (1W: -19.50% | 1M: -38.34%), TRMET (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -25.34%) and HEKTS (1W: -13.79% | 1M: -18.98%). All five are BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Upside momentum is limited to HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), both in RECOVERY. Downside momentum is strongest in KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%) and GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%), both BELOW TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking fell 4.20% over 1W and 7.65% over 1M; HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) is RECOVERY, while AKBNK (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -10.33%), GARAN (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -2.24%), ISCTR (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -7.80%) and YKBNK (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -2.86%) are BELOW TREND. The isolated HALKB bounce does not yet signal a sector reversal.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry was weak, down 8.49% over 1W and 19.05% over 1M. EREGL (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.71%), FROTO (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -15.96%), TOASO (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -20.36%) and ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%) are all BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals was the second-weakest sector, down 10.21% over 1W and 19.76% over 1M. GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%), HEKTS (1W: -13.79% | 1M: -18.98%), SASA (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -24.17%) and TUPRS (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -10.60%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a defensive stance, prioritize liquidity and limit exposure to persistent downtrends while breadth remains at 0/8. Require improving participation and sustained weekly recoveries before adding risk; avoid treating isolated rebounds as confirmed reversals.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%) for follow-through on their RECOVERY moves, and SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%) for relative resilience despite its BELOW TREND status. Watch KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%) for stabilization after steep losses; it remains BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Banking & Finance for any broadening beyond HALKB’s recovery, and Holding & Investment for follow-through after leading on a relative basis. Technology & Telecom merits close attention after the steepest sector decline.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so avoid relying on unverified price levels. Key triggers are a sustained improvement in sector breadth from 0/8 and volatility holding near its current 29.1% level.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market is NEUTRAL by the supplied regime reading, but normal volatility masks exceptionally weak breadth, with all eight sectors negative on a 1W basis. HALKB and SAHOL offer early recovery signals; broad sector confirmation is needed, while sharp losses in technology, energy and heavy industry remain the principal risk.
